Icy.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, Freeze 2 enemy items for 4000 second(s).
Icy.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，冻结2件敌人物品4000秒。

Turbo.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, Haste 4 items for 4000 second(s).
Turbo.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，加速4件物品4000秒。

Shielded.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, Shield equal to 20% of your Max Health.
Shielded.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，获得护盾，等量于最大生命值的20%。

Restorative.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, Heal equal to 20% of your Max Health.
Restorative.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，获得治疗，等量于最大生命值的20%。

Toxic.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, Poison 40.
Toxic.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，造成40剧毒。

Fiery.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, Burn 40.
Fiery.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，造成40灼烧。

Shiny.effect_en: This has double Max Health and Crit Chance bonus.
Shiny.effect_cn: 此物品的最大生命值和暴击率加成翻倍。

Deadly.effect_en: This has double Crit Chance bonus.
Deadly.effect_cn: 此物品的暴击率加成翻倍。

Radiant.effect_en: Adjacent items are affected by Freeze and Slow for half as long.
Radiant.effect_cn: 相邻物品受到的冻结和减速效果时长减半。

Obsidian.effect_en: The first time you fall below half Health each fight, deal Damage equal to 20% of your Max Health.
Obsidian.effect_cn: 每场战斗己方生命值首次降至一半时，造成伤害，等量于最大生命值的20%。
